It doesn’t feel like it only happens when I’m thinking about him. I mean, reminders of him can upset me, of course, but this restless feeling is more like it’s just there in me.

========== OUTPUT [patient] ==========
I guess the simplest way to say it is… I came in because I feel like I can’t settle inside my own skin anymore. That’s what it feels like. Like there’s this pressure in me to get up, move, do the next thing, fix something, start something — even when I’m tired, even when I know I ought to just sit down and be still for a minute.

It’s not just being “busy,” if that makes sense. It feels more like I’m driven from the inside. I’ll sit down and almost right away I feel like I can’t stay there, like I have to jump up again. And sometimes I’m worn out while I’m doing it, so it doesn’t even feel useful. It’s just this constant unsettled feeling, like my body won’t let me rest.
